subtasks.title: Return nothing for n <= 0 in lastN
subtasks.description: In src/lastn.ts, lastN() returns xs.slice(-n); for n = 0 that is xs.slice(0), the whole array, and a negative n returns items from the front. Return [] when n <= 0.
